reviews.title: AI allowance reduced, but restoration declined after conflicting explanations
reviews.text:
My experience with Notion AI support has damaged my trust in the service.

For transparency, my workspace was on a Business trial/promotional offer. This complaint concerns usage benefits and the handling of a dispute, not a cash charge.

After an unexpected usage change, I contacted support. Replies initially described an incorrect usage-percentage display. Support said it had repaired the issue, and I acknowledged that the displayed allowance appeared normal again.

The Billing Support Manager later confirmed that my workspace’s maximum AI allowance had been reduced, causing me to reach the limit sooner and use the reset and available credits. The same reply declined restoration, compensation or a membership extension.

My original screenshot shows 330 credits used cumulatively; it does not prove all 330 resulted from this incident. The plan listed 300 included credits per month. The email exchange has not supplied an itemized ledger or a clear explanation of when, why and by how much the allowance changed.

I want an explanation that reconciles the replies, restoration of attributable credits and the reset or their equivalent, and reasonable consideration of the disruption. Promotional access should not prevent a transparent review of an admitted allowance reduction and its consequences. I remain open to a fair resolution.
reviews.author: Reviewer 3

reviews.title: Solid for docs and team notes
reviews.text: I've used Notion for project docs and personal notes for a while. Linked databases keep sprint notes and specs in one place without another wiki. Sync is fine across laptop and phone; search gets a bit noisy once the workspace gets big.
reviews.author: Reviewer 4

reviews.title: I find everything in Notion a bit too chaotic
reviews.text: I really tried using it and it seems to be capable of a lot but there is simply too much going on and I need to pay to continue using basic features which would have been ok if I did not find the tool so overwhelming.
